vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Renovate defaults this to null for security fixes.

customManagers.description: The Picard release the tests run against, and the README lines that name it. tests/test_renovate.py checks these still match.

packageRules.description: requires-python pins the test venv's Python (see tools/run_tests.py); bump it by hand, not with Renovate.

Automerge non-major updates through GitHub's auto-merge, which waits for the approving review and the gate check that main requires. Not digest: a re-pointed tag keeps its old release date, so it skips minimumReleaseAge.
